product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Decorative Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Add a touch of elegance to your festive decor with this handcrafted decorative tealight holder set. Featuring vibrant pink lotus-inspired designs, intricate golden detailing, sparkling mirror accents, colourful stone embellishments, and delicate pearl borders, these holders beautifully combine traditional Indian artistry with a luxurious finish. The central golden holders are ideal for enhancing your festive arrangements and creating a graceful ambience. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja rooms, festive table settings, wedding decor, and special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid water, excessive moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Handle the pearl borders, mirrors, and decorative stones carefully to prevent damage.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the colours and golden finish.
If using with tealight candles, ensure the candle flame does not come into direct contact with the holder to prevent damage.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
